name: Curled in Ice
source:
Secluded in a mountain log cabin, Krita grows increasingly desperate to track down one of zir cherished cryptids—the elusive Tazzlebeast, known only from legends. Meanwhile, zir deaf girlfriend, Florentine, is more concerned with winning Krita’s favor, having known zir only as a college friend until recently. Krita has been distant for quite a while.

[From [url=https://scoliwings.itch.io/curled-in-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克丽塔隐居在一座山间小木屋里，他越来越不顾一切地想要追踪齐尔珍爱的神秘生物之一——难以捉摸的塔兹兽，只在传说中才为人所知。与此同时，zir的聋哑女友Florentine更关心赢得Krita的青睐，直到最近才将zir作为大学朋友认识。Krita已经疏远了一段时间了。

[来自[url=https://scoliwings.itch.io/curled-in-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
